class.name: SceneService
class.brief_description: Manages scene tree replacement without destroying the Application.
class.description:
SceneService replaces the child subtree under the root [Control] without using [method SceneTree.change_scene_to_file], which would destroy the [Application] instance. The root Control (and its owning GDScript) survives the switch, so the [Application], [ServiceRegistry], [ResourceManager], and [ActivityManager] remain intact.
When switching scenes, [method change_scene] or [method change_scene_sync] automatically calls [method ActivityManager.cleanup_all] to drain old Activities, Dialogs, and Toasts, then replaces the root's child node with the new scene's root.

method.name: change_scene
method.description: Asynchronously loads the [code].tscn[/code] at [param path] and replaces the root's child subtree when ready. During loading, [method get_loading_progress] can be polled.

method.name: change_scene_sync
method.description: Synchronously loads and applies the scene immediately. Blocks until the load is complete.

method.name: change_scene_with_callback
method.description: Asynchronously loads the scene and calls [param callback] when complete.

method.name: get_current_scene
method.description: Returns the path of the currently loaded scene.

method.name: get_loading_progress
method.description: Returns the loading progress as a value from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code].

method.name: is_loading
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while a scene is being loaded asynchronously.

method.name: preload_scene
method.description: Preloads a scene into the resource cache without switching to it.
